title: Four folding doors across a wide opening
summary: A new frame in a wide opening between two rooms, with four pine panel doors hung in pairs that fold back to open the rooms up.
intro: A wide opening between two rooms with no frame and no doors, just rough brick at the edges. I made a new frame to fit it, 140 mm deep to match the wall, and hung four narrow pine panel doors in two pairs. Each pair folds back on itself, so the rooms can be one big space or two. New architraves on both sides finish it off.

cover.alt: Four pine folding doors closed across a wide opening, with new architraves

steps.title: A wide opening, no frame
steps.text: A wide opening between two rooms, about 1600 mm across and 2200 mm high, with rough brick edges and nothing in it. The wall is 140 mm thick, so the new frame had to be 140 deep to match.

image.alt: The wide opening between the two rooms, its edges still rough and no frame in it

steps.title: A frame cut to the drawing
steps.text: I worked the sizes out on paper first: four doors at 382 mm with a 3 mm gap round each, so 1543 mm inside the frame. The head is 1599 mm long and the two legs 2208 mm.

image.alt: Pine frame boards cut to length on the floor

steps.title: Lined up with the opening
steps.text: The tricky part was lining the frame up with the opening. It stands plumb and square, checked with a laser level, so the doors hang true and the architraves sit flat on both sides.

image.alt: The new frame standing in the opening, propped and checked with a laser level

steps.title: Hung in two pairs
steps.text: Four narrow pine panel doors, hung in two pairs. Each pair is hung on the frame and hinged together, so the two doors fold back as one. Parliament hinges and standard 4 inch door hinges do the work.

image.alt: Both pairs of doors hung in the new frame, part open

steps.title: Architraves on
steps.text: New architraves go round the frame on both sides, which covers the rough edge of the opening and finishes it like any other doorway in the house.

image.alt: The closed doors from the side, with the architraves on

steps.title: Folds out of the way
steps.text: Open, each pair folds back at its side of the opening, so the two rooms are one. Closed, it is a wall of panelled doors.

image.alt: The doors folded back in pairs at each side, looking through to the back room

model3d.title: The doors in 3D
model3d.text: The frame and doors drawn in 3D to the real sizes from my notes: 1543 mm inside the frame, four doors 382 mm wide and 2200 mm high, in a 140 mm wall. The door thickness, the architraves and the panel heights are standard sizes. Fold the doors open, or take it apart to see the frame.
